topics.label: Lecture opening and introduction
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer welcomes the class and introduces the scope of the lecture on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Pathogen and damage sensing through molecular patterns
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the criteria by which the innate immune system detects infections and tissue damage while distinguishing self from non-self.

topics.label: Toll-like receptor localization and signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the genomic encoding, subcellular distribution, and intracellular signaling pathways of pattern recognition receptors with a focus on Toll-like receptors.

topics.label: Cytoplasmic PRRs and inflammasome activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine cytosolic danger-sensing receptors and the multi-protein inflammasome platform that processes mature inflammatory cytokines.

topics.label: Sentinel cell activation, leukocyte recruitment, and systemic consequences
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how initial sentinel cell activation orchestrates leukocyte extravasation into tissues, lymphatic priming, and systemic complications like sepsis.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic containment
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics cover the mechanisms required to extinguish inflammatory signals, repair damaged tissues, and manage persistent pathology via granuloma formation.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the presentation and announces the subject of the next lecture.
